findings.title: Lint negation matching treats a bare "not" anywhere in the span's sentence as negating
findings.action: No change: the miss direction is fail-closed (a real invocation stops counting, so the capture lints FAIL loudly); a false pass is impossible.

findings.title: Dangling run-start capture base when plot refuses after a plan token
findings.refutation: Spec §4.3 step 3 decides this explicitly: when plot refuses or errors, the run-start consult stays action-uncaptured, which is the honest record because the planned action was not taken. The base carries a non-empty correlation id, so it is not the FAFF-1009 empty-id class.
